description_en: Queries the CIDR block information in an IP address pool
description_zh: 调用ListPublicIpAddressPoolCidrBlocks接口查询IP地址池中的IP地址网段信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-public-ip-address-pool-cidr-blocks --public-ip-address-pool-id pippool-6wetvn6fumkgycssx0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPublicIpAddressPoolCidrBlocks

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPAM pool
parameters.name: public_ip_address_pool_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量，取值范围：10~100，默认为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no subsequent query exists.
If a subsequent query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without querying the CIDR block information in the IP address pool. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会查询IP地址池中的IP地址网段信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the CIDR block that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的IP地址网段所在的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

PublicIpPoolCidrBlockList.description_en: The list of CIDR blocks in the IP address pool
PublicIpPoolCidrBlockList.description_zh: IP地址池的IP地址网段数据列表

items.description_en: The CIDR block struct of the IP address pool
items.description_zh: IP地址池的IP地址网段结构体

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the CIDR block was created. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format

PublicIpAddressPoolId.description_en: The instance ID of the IPAM pool

Status.description_en:
The status of the CIDR block in the IP address pool. Valid values:
Created: available.
Deleting: being deleted.
Modifying: being modified
Status.description_zh:
IP地址池中的IP地址网段状态。取值：
Created：可用。
Deleting：删除中。
Modifying：修改中

TotalIpNum.description_en: The total number of available IP addresses in the CIDR block of the IP address pool
TotalIpNum.description_zh: IP地址池中IP地址网段的可用IP地址总数

UsedIpNum.description_en: The number of used IP addresses in the CIDR block of the IP address pool
UsedIpNum.description_zh: IP地址池中IP地址网段的已用IP地址数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下的数据总量
